title: New Zealand Dollar: Growth risks temper RBNZ pricing – ING
summary: ING notes that New Zealand’s Q2 GDP slowdown could magnify market impact given infrequent data, but the Reserve Bank of New Zealand remains focused on inflation and jobs.

title: Gold rebounds as traders position for Fed interest rate decision
summary: Gold (XAU/USD) rebounds on Wednesday as sellers trim their exposure ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement.

title: Euro trades with caution against US Dollar ahead of Fed’s policy meeting
summary: The Euro (EUR) trades subduedly at around 1.1535 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday. The major currency pair trades cautiously ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement at 18:00 GMT.
